program_source='''def transform(grid):
    g = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(g), len(g[0])
    seen = set()
    comps = []
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            v = g[r][c]
            if not v or v == 2 or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            q = [(r, c)]
            seen.add((r, c))
            comp = []
            while q:
                x, y = q.pop()
                comp.append((x, y))
                for nx, ny in ((x + 1, y), (x - 1, y), (x, y + 1), (x, y - 1)):
                    if 0 <= nx < h and 0 <= ny < w and (nx, ny) not in seen and g[nx][ny] == v:
                        seen.add((nx, ny))
                        q.append((nx, ny))
            comps.append((v, comp))

    direction = -1 if all(v == 2 for v in g[0]) else 1 if all(v == 2 for v in g[-1]) else 1
    while True:
        moved = False
        for i, (v, co) in enumerate(comps):
            dest = [(r + direction, c) for r, c in co]
            if all(0 <= r < h and (g[r][c] == 0 or (r, c) in co) for r, c in dest):
                for r, c in co:
                    g[r][c] = 0
                co = [(r + direction, c) for r, c in co]
                for r, c in co:
                    g[r][c] = v
                comps[i] = (v, co)
                moved = True
        if not moved:
            break
    return g
'''
